prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A luxurious, modern bedroom bathed in soft, natural daylight streaming through expansive floor-to-ceiling glass doors that open onto a lush, minimalist patio garden. The room features a large, plush bed with crisp white linens, layered with textured throws and an assortment of pillows in neutral tones, creating a sense of comfort and elegance. The headboard wall is a deep, matte gray, adorned with two striking black-and-white abstract art prints in simple frames, adding a sophisticated, contemporary touch. Sleek, black pendant lights with exposed bulbs hang symmetrically on either side of the bed, casting a warm, ambient glow that contrasts gently with the daylight. A dark bedside table holds a vase of fresh pink and white flowers, enhancing the serene, inviting atmosphere. The overall color palette is muted and refined, dominated by shades of gray, white, and black, with subtle accents of blush and greenery from the outdoor view. The composition is balanced and airy, with clean lines and a sense of spaciousness, evoking a cinematic, high-end interior design aesthetic. The camera angle is wide and slightly elevated, capturing both the intimate details of the bedroom and the seamless connection to the outdoor space, emphasizing tranquility and modern luxury.
